title: fix: move new-column indexes after migration
body:
## Summary
- The 4:15 AM pipeline crashed with `no such column: score` on existing databases
- `CREATE INDEX` for `score` and `last_seen_at` was in SCHEMA (runs before `_migrate()`)
- Moved these indexes into `_migrate()` so they run after columns are added

## Test plan
- [ ] Pipeline runs against existing DB without crash
- [ ] Fresh DB still creates all indexes
- [ ] All tests pass
